QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Test Your Might
QuestInfo.0: Continue your conversation with #bLavi#k at the #bExplorer Base#k.
QuestInfo.1: Lavi at the Explorer Base wants to see if you're strong enough to aid in the investigation. Hunt #r50 Mantises and Bloody Mantises#k on the #bColossus West Road#k as well as #r100 Poison Mantises#k on the #bColossus Dangerous Road#k.
QuestInfo.2: You proved your strength to #bLavi#k. Talk to #bKupo#k to press on with the exploration.

0.0: We're grateful for your help, but... we can't ask you to put yourself in danger without knowing whether you can handle it. I'm going to need you to prove yourself first.
0.1: Take out 50 Mantises, 50 Bloody Mantises#k, and #r100 Poison Mantises#k. Are you willing to do that?

yes.0: I'll be watching.\r\n#b#e(Go to the Colossus West Road and hunt Mantises.)#k

no.0: What, you think you can keep those fingers forever?

1.0: All right. I guess you're tough enough for the #bStone Colossus#k expedition, but don't come complaining to me if you get your teeth knocked out!

yes.0: You need to go to rock mountain summit to investigate Stone Colossus. It will take 3 days and 2 nights if you walk, so it's much faster to get on Kupo's Ride. Talk to #bKupo#k.\r\n#b#e(Talk to Kupo at the Explorer Base.)

mob.0: Take out #r50 Mantises, 50 Bloody Mantises, and 100 Poison Mantises#k.
